readings.core_relation: SELF-RAG 7B raises ASQA citation precision/recall over Llama2-FT 7B but slightly lowers correctness. Ablation supports the combined training configuration; inference settings trade attribution against fluency and accuracy.
readings.scope: Same five ASQA passages and 150,000 training pairs; ablation uses 50,000 examples and 150 questions. Retrieval reduction hurts PopQA more than PubHealth.
readings.witness: better evidence attribution rather than a gain on every answer metric
readings.unclear: Separate effects of retrieval-aware training and reflection tokens are not recoverable.

readings.core_relation: Controlled position and distractor changes reveal that larger context windows and successful exact lookup do not establish effective question-answering evidence use: middle placements degrade accuracy, and reader gains saturate before retrieval recall.
readings.scope: Multi-document QA and UUID retrieval; extended-window comparisons use inputs fitting both windows. Query repetition repairs synthetic retrieval, not QA; Claude variants nearly perfectly retrieve UUIDs.
readings.witness: accommodating more tokens and retrieving a matching value are insufficient indicators

readings.core_relation: Move a supported answer passage within a fixed document set to isolate evidence-position effects; vary distractor count to test additional material. Closed-book/oracle controls distinguish memory-based answering from undistracted evidence use.
readings.scope: 2,655 paragraph-answer NaturalQuestions-Open queries; 10/20/30 documents; answer-filtered distractors. UUID lookup reduces semantic confounds; query repetition tests task differences. Greedy outputs count correct-answer/value containment.
readings.witness: changes its position without changing the answer or removing its support

readings.core_relation: GPT-3.5-Turbo drops from 88.3% oracle accuracy to below its 56.1% closed-book baseline among distractors; 16K adds little on shared-length inputs. Query repetition fixes UUID retrieval, not QA, separating lookup from evidence-use difficulty.
readings.scope: Worst 20/30-document QA configurations; standard/16K comparison uses 10/20 documents fitting both windows. At 300 UUID pairs, 16K retrieval improves from 45.6% worst-case to perfect.
readings.witness: Making exact lookup easier therefore does not remove the positional difficulty

readings.core_relation: Self-RAG 13B has higher ASQA citation precision than retrieval-augmented ChatGPT but lower recall/correctness. The 7B PopQA gain over same-data Llama2-FT suggests benefits beyond example availability; customization exposes support/fluency and retrieval/accuracy tradeoffs.
readings.scope: ASQA uses five identical passages; precision 70.3 versus 65.1, recall 71.3 versus 76.6, correctness 31.7 versus 40.7. PopQA accuracy: 54.9% versus 48.7%; reduced retrieval harms PopQA more than PubHealth.
readings.unclear: Separate training and reflection effects are not recoverable.

readings.core_relation: Reorder a fixed question's answer-bearing document among answer-filtered distractors to isolate position from evidence availability; vary document count to test context length. Closed-book and oracle prompts anchor no-evidence and distraction-free performance.
readings.scope: 2,655 paragraph-annotated NaturalQuestions-Open queries; 10/20/30 documents. Serialized UUID JSON has 75/140/300 pairs and 500 examples per setting. Greedy decoding scores answer/value containment; UUIDs test minimal-language token matching.
readings.witness: makes position, rather than answer availability, the quantity under test

readings.core_relation: Query repetition gives GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K) perfect UUID retrieval from 45.6% worst-case accuracy but leaves QA positional sensitivity intact. Flan-UL2 becomes middle-sensitive beyond its training window, while larger GPT windows give little advantage on shared-length inputs. Thus task and training length qualify nominal capacity.
readings.scope: 300 UUID pairs; Flan-UL2's within-window positional spread is 1.9 percentage points at 2,048 tokens. Standard/16K comparison uses 10/20 documents fitting both windows.
readings.witness: task demands and training context relevant to evaluating long-context capability

readings.core_relation: Self-RAG trains reflection judgments that rank passage-conditioned sentence candidates, making evidence assessment determine continuations. Adjustable retrieval/scoring offers evidence-aware decoding without retraining or an inference-time critic, but higher citation precision need not improve other response qualities.
readings.scope: Critic trained on GPT-4 judgments annotates examples offline; zero-shot 7B/13B evaluation covers six tasks. On identical five-passage ASQA inputs, 13B precision rises versus ChatGPT while recall falls; stronger support weighting lowers MAUVE.
readings.witness: rather than merely accompanying the response

readings.core_relation: Self-RAG generates retrieval and critique tokens, then uses its own support-aware scores to select passage-conditioned sentences. Offline critic supervision enables adjustable evidence use; gains in attribution or factual accuracy do not imply uniformly better answers.
readings.scope: Zero-shot 7B/13B evaluations span factual QA, classification, biographies, and cited long-form answers. Same-data 7B PopQA accuracy rises 48.7% to 54.9%; ASQA precision beats ChatGPT but recall/correctness lag, and stronger support weighting reduces fluency.
readings.witness: makes predicted evidence support part of sentence selection

readings.core_relation: SELF-RAG learns retrieval decisions and separate relevance/support/utility judgments to select sentences, letting users adjust evidence emphasis without retraining or an inference-time critic. This improves attribution while exposing correctness and fluency tradeoffs.
readings.scope: Offline GPT-4-feedback critic; zero-shot 7B/13B Llama 2 evaluation on six tasks. With five identical ASQA documents and matched instruction-output data, 7B precision is 66.9% versus 5.0%, but correctness is lower; increased support weight lowers MAUVE.
readings.witness: rather than a uniform gain across response qualities

readings.core_relation: Query repetition lifts GPT-3.5-Turbo (16K) UUID lookup from 45.6% worst-position to 100% without fixing QA position effects; Claude also combines near-perfect lookup with position-sensitive QA. More available evidence therefore need not yield better answers.
readings.scope: 300 UUID pairs. Some GPT-3.5-Turbo 20/30-document cases underperform 56.1% closed-book accuracy; reader gains become marginal beyond 20 retrieved documents although recall keeps improving.
readings.witness: repairing lookup does not resolve the broader evidence-use problem

readings.core_relation: Position/context-length diagnostics show that accepting longer inputs does not ensure evidence use: middle passages hurt QA, larger windows offer little on shared inputs, and improved lookup leaves QA positional failures. Saturating reader accuracy despite rising recall identifies an evidence-use bottleneck.
readings.scope: Multi-document QA and synthetic key-value tasks preserve the answer. Encoder-decoder robustness holds within training context lengths but degrades beyond them; some QA cases underperform no-document answering.
readings.witness: successful token retrieval need not entail effective evidence use

readings.core_relation: Train a generator on response and offline critic reflection tokens, then rank each passage-conditioned sentence through segment-level beam search combining generation likelihood with relevance/support/utility probabilities. Separately scoring support lets predicted grounding influence continuation selection.
readings.scope: Llama 2 critic distilled from GPT-4 feedback; passage context is excluded from training loss. Weighted, normalized favorable-token probabilities and a retrieval threshold are adjustable without retraining or an inference-time critic.
readings.witness: separating whether to obtain evidence from how strongly support should influence answer selection

readings.core_relation: Moving evidence and varying distractors reveals that context capacity and exact matching do not establish reliable evidence use: QA favors context ends, and query repetition repairs UUID lookup without repairing QA positional sensitivity.
readings.scope: 2,655 NaturalQuestions-Open queries plus random UUID retrieval. Shared-window comparisons show similar standard/extended profiles; Claude-1.3 nearly perfectly retrieves UUIDs. GPT-3.5-Turbo can underperform no-document QA despite supplied evidence.
readings.witness: how much text a model can accept

readings.core_relation: Same-data Self-RAG 7B improves PopQA accuracy and ASQA precision over Llama2-FT but slightly reduces ASQA correctness. 13B beats retrieved ChatGPT on precision, not recall/correctness; support weighting and retrieval frequency introduce costs, supporting tunable rather than uniformly superior evidence use.
readings.scope: 7B gains: PopQA 48.7% to 54.9%; precision 5.0% to 66.9%; correctness 31.0% to 30.0%. The 13B comparison uses identical five ASQA documents and zero retrieval threshold. Less retrieval harms PopQA more than PubHealth.
readings.witness: raises citation precision but lowers MAUVE

readings.core_relation: Train the generator to emit text and offline critic judgments; trigger retrieval by thresholding normalized retrieval-token probability. Generate sentence candidates per passage and retain high-scoring continuations using segment-level beam search, so predicted support affects claims selected.
readings.scope: Llama 2-7B critic trained on GPT-4 feedback; next-token training excludes passage text from loss. Candidate scores combine generation and weighted favorable-critique probabilities; priorities change without retraining or inference-time critic evaluation.
readings.witness: using predicted evidence support as a decoding criterion

readings.core_relation: Move annotated answer paragraphs among unchanged distractors to isolate position; vary document count to test added distraction. Closed-book and single-answer-document controls distinguish stored knowledge from directly accessible evidence; moving UUID targets tests position with minimal linguistic content.
readings.scope: 2,655 NaturalQuestions-Open queries; answer-filtered Contriever Wikipedia distractors; 10/20/30 documents. JSON lookup uses 75/140/300 UUID pairs, 500 examples per size. Greedy outputs are scored by answer/value containment.
readings.witness: rather than requiring an exact match to the entire response

readings.core_relation: Offline critic annotations train a generator to produce text and relevance/support/utility judgments. During retrieval, passage-conditioned sentences are beam-ranked by generation likelihood plus weighted reflection probabilities; separate support scoring can penalize relevant but incompletely supported claims before selection.
readings.scope: Llama 2 critic trained on GPT-4 judgments; next-token loss excludes retrieved passage text. Scores use normalized probabilities, with adjustable critique weights/retrieval threshold and no retraining or inference-time critic.
readings.witness: rather than supplying feedback after selection
